page.overview:
Who is Abraham Erskine?

Dr. Abraham Erskine was a brilliant scientist and a member of the Nazi party. As part of a German program to usurp the resources of enemy nations for development of Nazi technology, Erskine began working for the U.S. government on Project Rebirth, with the goal of creating super-soldiers for use in World War II. The Americans were unaware that Erskine's true goal was to create the perfect Aryan race, hence why they chose Steven Rogers, a scrawny, blonde, blue-eyed young man as their first subject.

The experiment was a success, but when a Nazi agent attempted to assassinate Rogers soon after the success of the experiment, the stray bullet killed Erskine instead. As a result, the method of creating more super-soldiers was lost to both the Germans and Americans, and Steve Rogers would become vital in the defeat of Nazi Germany during World War II.

Both Rogers and the Americans would remain unaware of Erskine's true allegiance until the Red Skull revealed the truth to Rogers decades later.
